Couples app · in progress

Dibs

Some things surface in the middle of an ordinary day. The car payment, the pickup on Thursday. You can't settle them alone, and you don't want to carry them until you can. Dibs lets you toss it up so it leaves your head and lands somewhere you'll both see it, then you decide together who takes it. Once someone calls dibs, it's handled, and you can both stop holding it.

Catch it now, or toss it up
Handle it now, or toss it up
Out of your head, into the open
Decide together who takes it
Both of you, one timeline
Two accounts, one household

Family app · shipped

Holy Week

A nine-day scripture study experience built for three families to walk through Holy Week together. Each day opens to a reading, a question to sit with, and something to actually do. Everyone can see how far along the rest of the family has gotten.

Pick your family, pick up where you left off
Everyone's progress, side by side
A day opens to its reading
Ponder, do it together, mark it done
